visualCharacteristics: Two auto-scrolling marquee rows of portrait entertainment cards with channel logos and a hover "Bekijk meer" button, plus a play/pause toggle and a closing outline CTA.
contentPattern: One row per card: cell 1 holds the card picture plus an optional channel-logo picture, cell 2 holds a link paragraph (accessible card label) and an optional copyright paragraph; a final row without images holds the CTA paragraph (em link = outline button). Cards are split evenly over the two lanes.
usage: Use to show a large, continuously scrolling wall of content titles (series, films, sports) as visual inspiration with one overall CTA.
reuseGuidance: Reuse wherever many linked poster cards should animate as a marquee; for user-controlled sliders use media-carousel or feature-cards instead.
